images.caption: Front of Our House, a historic house located at 434 First Avenue in Gallipolis, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1819, the house is listed on the National Register of Historic Places, and it is part of a Register-listed historic district, the Gallipolis Historic District.

images.caption: Front and southeastern end of the Gallia County Courthouse, located at 18 Locust Street in Gallipolis, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1985, it is the county's fifth courthouse; the first was demolished by the county government, while the second, third, and fourth were all destroyed by fire.
